Its only job is to prove the code paths execute: parity guard, corpus, M108-exact whitener + candidates, deterministic dictionary rebuild, ITQ fit, random-projection fit, bit packing, XOR+POPCNT Hamming, triangle + uneven-edge pooling, ridge heads, per-domain eval, binary MAC/op ledger, and both kill switches evaluate.
